description: The same judgement in two more template languages, each marking the unsafe form with one character: Pug writes `!=` and `!{}` where `=` and `#{}` escape, and Handlebars writes a third brace or an ampersand. The escaped interpolations in both files -- including the one inside a Handlebars block helper -- are silent, and neither extractor reads a Pug attribute list as an interpolation.

expected.note: a third brace turns escaping off
an ampersand does the same thing
